Definition: from a compound of G1909 and G2147; a discoverer, i.e. contriver:--inventor.
BiblicalUsage: Epheuretes is an inventor — of evil things. Paul lists it among the sins of those who knew God and refused Him: inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents, without understanding.
TheologicalSignificance: Evil is not only committed, it is invented, and a heart that invents evil has turned its creativity against God.
